tactical_thesis: Replace the separate Melantha-to-Spot relay with permanent lower-outer Spot, retain both physicians, and transfer eastern lower-roadblock damage to Steward. This seven-ID hypothesis restores two-physician recovery at the artillery station while retaining four ground interceptions. Spot supplies temporary recovery for Ansel during the second lower barrage. Steward rotates centrally after artillery clearance and later clears both western restraints from two deployments. Survival, target allocation and clearance remain unverified; this is not a claimed WIN.
